description: Group updates avoid duplicate includes, preserve user overrides when refreshing added groups, and remove checks for removed groups.

input.initial_yaml:
---
challenge: Yes
includes:
  - keep
  - refresh
  - old
version: 0.2.2
checks:
- from: keep
  test: keep-pattern
  method: Contains
  enable: true
  description: "keep desc"
- from: refresh
  test: refresh-pattern
  method: Regex
  enable: false
  challenge: Math
  description: "custom refresh desc"
- from: old
  test: old-pattern
  method: Regex
  enable: true
  description: "old desc"

cases.expected_output:
challenge=Yes
includes=keep,refresh,new-one
check_count=4
check=keep|Contains|true|Default|keep desc
check=refresh|Regex|false|Math|catalog refresh desc
check=new-one|Contains|true|Enter|new contains desc
check=refresh|Regex|false|Math|catalog refresh desc
